faq.content: FAQ Q: How long does delivery take? A: After payment verification, delivery is automatic — usually under 30 minutes during business hours. Q: What about warranty? A: Most accounts include a 30-day replacement warranty. Contact support if anything stops working. Q: Can I get a refund? A: Refunds are considered case by case. We always attempt a replacement first. Q: Why does the payment amount have odd decimals? A: A unique identifier is added to each order for payment matching. Do not round the amount.

web.faq_sub: Answers to the questions we hear most often
web.faq_a1: Once payment is confirmed, the product is delivered to your account automatically. Product details (credentials, codes, etc.) appear on your order page.
web.faq_a2: Yes! Products are covered. If a product doesn't work or doesn't match its description, contact us and we'll fix it at no extra cost.
web.faq_a3: We accept QRIS and USDT. Every payment is verified automatically.
web.faq_a4: Usually 1–10 minutes after payment is confirmed. Cases that need a manual check take at most 1–2 hours during working hours.
web.faq_a5: Open a support ticket from your Account page, or reach us on Telegram / WhatsApp. Our team is on 24 hours a day.
web.faq_a6: Yes. Every unit is tested before it enters stock, and what you receive is a product that genuinely works. If it turns out not to match the description, that's covered by the warranty.
web.faq_q7: Can I change the account's email or password?
web.faq_a7: Better not to, unless the product description says you may. Changing the login details means we can no longer verify or replace your unit, so the warranty is void.
web.faq_q8: Can I get a refund if I change my mind?
web.faq_a8: Yes, if the product hasn't been delivered yet or turns out to be unusable. Once it's been used, or if you picked the wrong plan, refunds don't apply — the Refund Policy page has the details.
web.faq_q9: What if the product breaks during the warranty period?
web.faq_a9: Open a support ticket and quote your order code. We check it, then repair or replace the unit. There's no extra charge while it's still under warranty.
web.faq_q10: Is there a better price for buying in bulk?
web.faq_a10: Yes. Quantity discounts apply automatically as soon as you hit the threshold — you'll see the reduction at checkout, no code to ask for.
web.faq_q11: Which network should I send USDT on?
web.faq_a11: Bybit internal transfer (by UID) or on-chain on the BEP20 / BSC network. Don't send on any other network — we can neither receive those funds nor return them.

web.about_intro: {shop} sells digital products with automatic delivery and a warranty on every order. This page explains what we sell and how it all works.
web.about_p1: Digital products: premium accounts and app subscriptions. Each product comes in several plans and durations; the price, what's included, and the warranty period are written on the product's own page.
web.about_p2: Stock is prepared and tested before it goes on sale. As soon as your payment is verified, the system takes one unit from stock and attaches it to your order — with no admin retyping anything.
web.about_p3: Ordering and automatic delivery run 24 hours a day, weekends and holidays included. For anything that needs a person — a warranty claim, an unusual question — our team replies in under an hour on average.
web.about_p4: The most traceable route is a support ticket from your Account page. If you'd rather chat, the Telegram and WhatsApp links are in the contact section of the home page.

web.hto_h1: 1. Pick a product and a plan
web.hto_p1: Open the product you want, then choose the plan and duration. The price, remaining stock, and warranty period are shown there. Buying more than one? Quantity discounts, where they exist, appear automatically at checkout.
web.hto_p2: Add it to your cart, then continue to checkout. Some products need extra details per unit — a destination email, say — and that form appears before payment. Fill it in carefully: a typo here is the most common cause of a delayed order.
web.hto_p3: Scan the QR code that appears and pay the exact amount shown. That amount is what the system uses to match your payment, so don't round it.
web.hto_p4: Send exactly the USDT amount shown, either by Bybit internal transfer (using our UID) or on-chain on the BEP20 / BSC network. Sending on any other network loses the funds — we can neither receive them nor send them back.
web.hto_p5: The order status changes on its own and your credentials appear on the order page, stored in your account and reopenable any time. If 15 minutes pass with no change, open a support ticket quoting your order code — don't pay twice.
web.terms_intro: These terms apply to every purchase at {shop}. By ordering, you're taken to have read them.
web.terms_p1: One account per person. Give accurate details and keep your password to yourself — we never ask for a password, OTP, or PIN over chat, and we aren't responsible for access gained through leaked login details.
web.terms_p2: What you buy is for your own use, as described in the plan. Sharing or reselling it without written permission from us voids the warranty and may get future orders declined.
web.terms_p3: Changing the account's login details (email, password, recovery number) unless the product description allows it; using the product for anything that breaks the provider's own rules; or handing the product to someone else.
web.terms_p4: Prices and stock can change at any time, but the price you see at checkout is the price you're charged. If stock turns out to be empty after you've paid, we offer a replacement or a full refund.
web.terms_p5: Our liability is limited to the value of the order in question. We don't cover indirect losses, and we can't guarantee the continuity of the third-party services whose products we sell.
web.privacy_intro: What {shop} stores about you, what it's used for, and how to have it deleted.
web.privacy_p1: Your account username and email, your password in encrypted form (we can't read it either), your order and payment history, the contents of your support tickets and reviews, and your Telegram ID if you link one.
web.privacy_p2: Processing orders, delivering products, handling warranty claims, and preventing abuse. We don't sell your data and we don't send promotions you didn't ask for.
web.privacy_p3: Payment providers receive the amount and the order code so your transaction can be matched — not the contents of your order or the credentials you receive. Beyond that, data leaves only on a lawful request from a competent authority.
web.privacy_p4: Credentials delivered to your order are visible only from your own account, and never appear in our system records or notifications. Still keep them safe: anyone who can get into your account can see them too.
web.privacy_p5: Order history is kept for as long as your account is active, because it's the basis for warranty and dispute handling. Want your account deleted? Open a support ticket — we remove your personal details and keep only the transaction records bookkeeping requires.
web.privacy_analytics_p: This site uses Google Analytics to count page visits in aggregate. That data isn't tied to your account or your orders.
web.refund_intro: When you get your money back, when you don't, and how to ask.
web.refund_p1: If we never delivered the product, stock turned out to be empty after you paid, or the product didn't work from the start and we can't replace it. In cases like these the refund is full, with nothing deducted.
web.refund_p2: If the product was delivered and works but you changed your mind, you picked the wrong plan or duration, or it broke because you changed the login details yourself. For a wrong plan, talk to us first — an exchange is often still possible.
web.refund_p3: Open a support ticket from your Account page with your order code and what happened. We check it from our side first; if it meets the criteria, it goes through without you having to chase us.
web.refund_p4: We can return it as account credit — available immediately and usable on your next purchase — or to your original payment method. The second depends on the payment provider and usually takes a few working days.
web.refund_p5: If a product dies or misbehaves during the warranty period, the warranty is the first route: we repair or replace the unit at no cost. A refund is the last resort, for when a replacement genuinely isn't possible.
admin.stock_err_no_valid: ⚠️ No valid credentials found. Expected format: email:password or email|password|extra One per line.
admin.voucher_step1: 🎟 Create Voucher — Step 1/3 Send the voucher code (3–32 chars, A–Z/0–9/_/-).
admin.voucher_step2: 🎟 Create Voucher — Step 2/3 ✓ Code: {code} Send the type and value, e.g. percent 10 (10% off) or fixed 5 (5 USDT off).
admin.voucher_step3: 🎟 Create Voucher — Step 3/3 ✓ Code: {code} ✓ Discount: {discount} Send the usage limit (whole number, 0 = unlimited).
admin.voucher_err_exists: ⚠️ That code already exists. Pick another.
admin.voucher_err_value: ⚠️ Value must be a positive number.
admin.voucher_created: ✅ Voucher created. 🎟 Code: {code} 💸 Discount: {discount} 🔁 Usage limit: {limit}
admin.user_search_ask: 🔎 Send a query (username, full name, or Telegram user ID):
admin.setting_prompt_binance_pay_id: 💳 Send the new Binance Pay ID (the numeric ID buyers transfer USDT to).
admin.setting_prompt_qr: 🖼 Send the new QR image as a photo. It will be shown to buyers at checkout.
admin.setting_prompt_banner_image: 📢 Send the new banner image as a photo. It appears on top of the main menu and the product list (never on payment screens). Send - to remove the banner.
admin.setting_prompt_welcome: 👋 Send the new welcome message. • Use {name} as a placeholder for the user's name. • HTML tags allowed (e.g. <b>bold</b>). • Send - to reset to the default message.
admin.setting_prompt_support_contact: 📞 Send the support contact (e.g. @yourusername or t.me/yourchannel). It will appear on /support. Send - to clear.
admin.prod_step1: 🛍 New Product — Step 1/6 Send the product name (e.g. Netflix Premium 1M).
admin.prod_step2: 🛍 New Product — Step 2/6 ✓ Name: {name} Pick the product type.
admin.prod_step3: 🛍 New Product — Step 3/6 ✓ Name: {name} ✓ Type: {type} Send the duration label (e.g. 1 Month).
admin.prod_step5: 🛍 New Product — Step 5/6 ✓ Price: {price} Send the reseller price in USDT (or - to skip).
admin.prod_step6: 🛍 New Product — Step 6/6 Send the warranty days (e.g. 30, or - for the default).
admin.prod_err_price: ⚠️ Invalid. Send a positive number, e.g. 5.00.
admin.prod_err_reseller: ⚠️ Invalid. Send a positive number or - to skip.
admin.prod_err_warranty: ⚠️ Invalid. Send a non-negative whole number or -.
admin.prod_created: ✅ Product {name} created. Next: add stock via /admin → 📦 Stock.
admin.bulk_step1: 💰 Bulk Pricing — Step 1/2 Send the minimum quantity (whole number ≥ 5). Customers who buy at least this many units get the discount.
admin.bulk_step2: 💰 Bulk Pricing — Step 2/2 ✓ Min quantity: {minQty} Send the discount percent (1–99, e.g. 10).
admin.banner_removed_undo: ✅ Banner removed. Tap ↩️ Undo below to restore it (within 30 seconds).
admin.undo_expired: Undo window expired — banner stays removed.
error.stale_screen: This screen is outdated — send /start to open a fresh menu.
